ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a China-Nepal border transportation map. The left side shows the transportation connections on the China Tibet side from Lhasa, Xigaze, Tingri, and Nyalam to Zhangmu, and then onward to Kathmandu, Nepal; Zhangmu is located near the China-Nepal border and is an important node connecting China’s Tibet with Nepal. The right side is an enlarged map of Zhangmu Port, marking National Highway 318 and the Friendship Bridge, showing that Zhangmu Port has a passage location connecting the transportation lines of China’s interior with the direction of Nepal. Then reason: the materials explain that Zhangmu is Tibet’s only national first-class land commercial port, radiating inward to Tibet and neighboring provinces and regions, and outward to Nepal and neighboring countries and regions. Therefore, its reasonable development direction should be positioned as a trade transit port, organizing the export of industrial products from the domestic hinterland to Nepal and other places. According to the principle of regional comparative advantage, the advantages of domestic manufacturing should be brought into play.
